source: The user's screenshots of Basketball-Reference's career points list (NBA/BAA, regular season), ranks 37-118, taken 11/21/26 with the 11/20 games not yet added (every player who played 11/20 is short by exactly that game), so ranks are through 11/19. Only retired players are kept (their totals no longer change); active players' totals come from the NBA Guide's year-by-year pages plus this season's box scores, and players already on the NBA Guide's career scorers list (ranks 1-68) keep the Guide's total (Dolph Schayes: the Guide 19,247, Basketball-Reference 18,438).
